name: Example: Calculating a Joint Probability Containing Inequalities From a Table
problem:
|  | $Y=0$ | $Y=2$ | $Y=4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=0$ | $0.15$ | $0.1$ | $0.1$ |
| $X=1$ | $0.05$ | $0.1$ | $0.05$ |
| $X=2$ | $0.05$ | $0.25$ | $0.15$ |

Compute $P\left( X\cdot Y \geq 4 \right)$ given that the random variables $X$ and $Y$ have the joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ shown in the table above.
